hints.title: Separate Even and Odd Positions
hints.text: Count frequencies of elements at even indices and odd indices independently.

hints.title: Find Top Frequencies
hints.text: Identify the two most frequent elements on even indices and the two most frequent elements on odd indices.

hints.title: Handle Collisions
hints.text: If the top even and odd elements differ, choose them. If they match, pair the top even with second odd, or second even with top odd.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all distinct pairs takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Examining only the top two candidates for each parity stream ensures linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Resolve element collision by considering runner-up candidates.
